observations.relevance: Directly checks the provenance handoff portion of the client-delivery article; not generation quality, export behavior or licensing permission.
observations.product: Adobe Content Authenticity Inspect Beta; public CAI example asset
observations.task: Inspect a supplied image's recorded creation history and warning before treating it as ready for a client handoff.

conditions.browser: Chrome extension-controlled browser, existing browser default viewport; no responsive-size override
conditions.account: Signed out: visible Sign in button; no account created or logged in
conditions.plan: Public Inspect Beta, no paid entitlement used
conditions.source: Official CAI public car JPEG; no user file or personal image

steps: Opened the exact public-sample Inspect URL linked by official CAI documentation.
Read the resulting Inspect view while it showed Sign in.
Activated Show sources (1), then read the source-history view and credential details.
Saved the resulting screenshot and DOM text.
observations.result: The viewer displayed the recorded name car-es-1sm.jpg, Created with Adobe Photoshop, and a warning that the file uses a legacy C2PA specification version. Expanding sources showed a single sample source node. The observed record is not a Firefly-generation test.
observations.readerImpact: A handoff check should record the displayed creation application and any credential warning instead of treating the existence of metadata as permission to use an asset. Follow with a separate check of actual model/account/input rights.
observations.limits: One public sample only. No SpicyBox or Firefly output was generated, uploaded, downloaded or exported; no commercial license or client permission was verified by the viewer. The sample result cannot establish either product's generation quality or export coverage.

observations.task: Exercise a per-attempt credit ceiling and compute cost per accepted clip.
steps: Calculate remaining credits after each debit.
Compare the remaining balance with another 30-credit attempt.
Divide total debits by accepted clips.
observations.result: The running balances were 70, 40 and 10. The fourth attempt exceeded the ceiling. One accepted clip cost 90 example credits.
observations.readerImpact: Use a ceiling to prevent another attempt and count the cost of discarded results.
observations.limits: Arithmetic simulation only. No vendor pricing, transaction, credit deduction or refund was tested.

observations.task: Check whether a crop can retain GPS metadata in the exported JPEG.
inputs: Original 160×120 abstract JPEG with a synthetic GPS tag
steps: Crop and save once with original EXIF passed to the encoder.
Save the same crop with no EXIF passed.
Reopen all three JPEGs and read the EXIF GPS directory.
observations.result: The original and metadata-preserving crop contained GPS tags. The copy saved without EXIF had no GPS tag.
observations.readerImpact: Check the exact exported file, even if the visible crop looks ready.
observations.limits: Local synthetic sample with no user image. It does not establish how mobile apps or SpicyBox process metadata.

officialSources.name: FFprobe official documentation
officialSources.note: The show_streams option reports the streams that exist. It does not establish whether an audio track carries audible sound.

officialSources.name: FFmpeg Filters documentation, silence detection
officialSources.note: The filter detects intervals at or below a configured threshold lasting at least the configured minimum duration.

observations.task: Determine whether a visibly playable silent MP4 has an audio stream.
inputs: Original abstract two-second MP4 with deliberately silent AAC audio
steps: Use ffprobe to enumerate video, audio and duration.
Run FFmpeg silencedetect at -50 dB over at least a quarter second.
Compare reported silence duration with the file duration.
observations.result: ffprobe reported H.264 320×180 video at 24 fps and an AAC stream. FFmpeg reported silence from 0 to 2 seconds.
observations.readerImpact: Sound can be absent in playback even when a file contains an audio track.
observations.limits: A local sample file, not a SpicyBox export. No vendor format, resolution, audio behavior or output quality was measured.
observations.conditions: Local Windows workstation; original synthetic or numerical sample only; all inputs local.
